ABOUT US
Grillin' on the beach since 2003!

 Established in 2003 by Freddie and Pat Peninger, Gulf Island Grill is known for its unique tropical flavors and world famous smoked ribs! We provide dine-in or carry out. From snowbirds to spring breakers, we guarantee you'll be satisfied.

Fresh seafood and savory burgers served everyday
SEE THE MENU
From margaritas to bushwackers 

Our drink menu has a variety of tropical cocktails, creamy bushwackers, and local craft beers to choose from!

with island flavors. Served with

and a grilled pineapple.

RIBEYE                                                $30

Hand cut and grilled to

your liking, served with

​

CARIBBEAN SHRIMP KABOBS       $24

choice of: grilled shrimp skewer,

crab. Served with Gulf Island 
potatoes and steamed veggies.

​

MAHI TACOS                                     $22

Fresh mahi mahi wrapped

in a flour tortilla shell with

homemade pico de gallo,

fresh lettuce, and shredded

cheese. Served with chips

and salsa and red beans & rice.

​

BAJA CATCH                                     $22

Fresh fish prepared grilled

or blackened. Served with

Caribbean rice and steamed veggies.

​

SHRIMP SCAMPI                               $22

Fresh gulf shrimp sautéed

in a garlic wine butter, served

with Caribbean rice and

steamed veggies.

HOUSE SPECiALTiES

GROUPER ROULADE                       $24

Fresh grouper stuffed with

crabmeat and broiled in a

garlic-wine butter cream sauce.

Served with mashed potatoes

and steamed veggies. 

​

BABY BACK RIBS                              $28

A full 2 lb. rack of ribs rubbed

with our island spices and slow

cooked. Toss them with your

choice of honey, jerk, or mango

BBQ sauce. Served with fries

and Key West slaw.

 

GROUPER PARMESAN                     $24

Baked grouper topped with

fresh parmesan. Served with

mashed potatoes and steamed

veggies.

​

GULF ISLAND YA-YA                        $23

Shrimp, chicken, Andouille

sausage, peppers, onions, and

tomatoes covered in our rich

garlic cheddar sauce on a bed

of Caribbean rice. Served with

garlic bread.

 

GULF ISLAND CATCH                      $22

Voted one of the BEST dishes

on the island. Lightly pan-fried

fish topped with our creamy

shrimp & andouille sausage

YA-YA sauce. Served with

steamed veggies.

​

ROASTED CHEDDAR                       $12

& ARTICHOKE DIP

Creamy dip served with

warm tortilla chips

​

COCONUT SHRIMP                          $14

Home made with a crispy

coconut batter, served with

our homemade Jezabel sauce

​

BOILED SHRIMP                                $14

A 1/2 pound of fresh Gulf

shrimp, served with

cocktail sauce. 

​

FRIED DILL PICKLE CHIPS               $10

Hand cut pickles, deep fried,

and tasty! Served with ranch.

​

BUFFALO SHRIMP                            $14

Hearty portion of popcorn

shrimp tossed in your choice of :

Honey BBQ - Mango BBQ - or Hot

​

BAKED CRAB                                     $14

STUFFED MUSHROOMS

Our signature crab dressing

with our garlic cream sauce.

​

CHEESY BACON FRIES                    $12

Melted cheese and crispy

bacon pieces atop our fries.

Served with ranch.

 

BLACKENED SHRIMP                       $14

QUESO
Blackened shrimp mixed
in creamy queso dip. Served

with tortilla chips.

​

LOUISIANA POPCORN                    $14

Spicy fried crawfish tails
served with mojo dipping sauce.

​

SANDWiCHES

PO'BOYS                                          $17

Shrimp, crawfish, or grouper served on French loaf bread with lettuce, tomato, and onion.

Shrimp and crawfish can be tossed in hot buffalo, mango BBQ, honey BBQ, or jerk BBQ

Grouper: Fried, Grilled, Or blackened​

​

JERK CHICKEN SANDWICH            $15

Marinated chicken breast with a

grilled pineapple on top. Served

between toasted buns with lettuce,

tomato, and onion.

​

ISLAND BURGER                               $14

1/2 lb. burger grilled with

our island spices! Add American,

Cheddar, Provolone, or Swiss

cheese for $1 extra. Add bacon,

sautéed mushrooms, or a grilled

pineapple for $2 extra.

FROM THE FRYER

FRIED GULF SHRIMP                     $22

10 golden brown shrimp

served with cocktail sauce.

​

FRIED GROUPER                               $20

Fresh and local grouper cut

into thin strips. Served with

tartar sauce.

​

FRIED CHICKEN TENDERS             $17

Fried, juicy chicken tenders. Served

with our homemade honey mustard.

​

BON SECOUR PLATTER                   $26

A variety of fried favorites! Comes

with fried grouper strips, crawfish
tails, gulf shrimp, & stuffed crab.

​

​

PASTA

SEAFOOD PASTA                             $24

Steamed shrimp & crawfish tails tossed in

a tasty parmesan sauce with

sautéed peppers and onions

over penne noodles.

​

CHICKEN ALFREDO                         $22

Savory grilled chicken tossed

in a tasty parmesan sauce with

sautéed peppers and onions

over penne noodles.

​

BLACKENED CHICKEN                    $22

ALFREDO

Creole-style blackened chicken

tossed in a tasty parmesan sauce

with sautéed peppers and onions

over penne noodles.

Served with french fries, Key West slaw, and a hushpuppy.

Served with toasted garlic bread.

DESSERTS

PEANUT BUTTER PIE                    $7.99

A creamy peanut butter pie

drizzled with chocolate syrup,

along with a chocolate cracker crust.

​

SALTED CARAMEL        CHEESECAKE                                 $7.99

Creamy, rich cheesecake with smooth caramel and a hint of sea salt for the perfect balance of sweet and savory

​

KEY LIME PIE                                  $7.99

A classic. Made with a

graham cracker crust and

drizzled with kiwi syrup.

Sides

Gulf island potatoes - Caribbean rice    steamed veggies  

 red beans & rice - Key West slaw

  corn cobette - boiled new potatoes

 French fries - hushpuppies

FROM THE STEAMER

BOILED SHRIMP                            $24

DINNER

Fresh local shrimp steamed

and seasoned with Old Bay.

Served with new potatoes,

corn, lemons, drawn butter &

a hushpuppy.

​

SNOW CRAB LEGS         MARKET PRICE

Your choice of 1 lb. or 2 lb.

steamed crab legs, seasoned

with Old Bay. Served with new

potatoes, corn, lemons, a

hushpuppy and drawn butter. 

​

ST. MARTIN PLATTER     MARKET PRICE

Feeding 2-3 people, this platter

has a variety! It contains a 1 1/2 lb.

of snow crab legs, a 1/2 lb. of

steamed shrimp, 4oz. of fried crawfish tails, 4 new potatoes, 2 pieces of corn,

hushpuppies, and Key West slaw.

Served with drawn butter and lemons.

OUR DRINK MENU

HOUSE SPECIALITY DRINKS



KOMONIWANALEIYA

Our original refreshing creation: 
made with vodka, blue curacao, island

punch liqueur, and tropical juices. 
Comes with a free lei! 

​

GULF ISLAND BUCKET

For a BEACHIN' time try this huge 

drink in a souvenir sand pail that's 

filled with long island liqueur, sour, 

cranberry, and sprite. 

​

MARGARITAS 

Get it frozen or on the rocks!

Flavors: original, strawberry, peach,

mango, raspberry, or watermelon. 

​

DAQUIRIES

Get it original or virgin!
Flavors: strawberry, piña colada,

peach, mango, banana, raspberry, or

watermelon. 

​

KISS MY MALIBU

Our island favorite made with 
Malibu rum, Jamaican rum, tropical

juices, and grenadine. 

​

BUSHWACKER 
An island tradition made with real 

ice cream, island rum, and

Kahlúa.
